title: Independent purpose-dependent acceptance authority closeout

GW-R.authority_available: Formal downstream LHM surface-water discharge/supply/water-balance criteria only.
GW-R.missing: Direct recharge/lower-boundary cumulative bias, seasonal/annual allocation, drift and domain/population requirements.
GW-R.why_downstream_not_substituted: No independent mapping isolates permissible recharge error from total-system surface-water response.

frozen: HYDRO-MEMORY Stage 0 numerical groundwater-head budget 0.004 m
transaction-safe accepted-state and exact-once interface-mass semantics
formal LHM 4.1 groundwater end-to-end application-output criteria
GW-D.blocker: The qualified public package omits source measurements withheld by data owners and is materially smaller than the report populations. Exact published-population replication is therefore not publicly reconstructible.
valid_resolution_paths: Obtain independent purpose-owner authority declaring the qualified public subset to be a new governed validation population.
For synthetic/component comparison, obtain an independent Layer-ROM structural-error allocation or direct component criterion.

SCI-P.frozen: Monthly growing-season soil-moisture correlation >=0.6 at the formal LHM national/regional/field-point supports.
SCI-P.missing: Absolute volumetric-water-content error, per-depth storage, profile shape, wetting/drying-front timing, extrema and local vertical flux/gradient requirements.
SCI-P.source_boundary: LHM explicitly warns that vertical support mismatch prevents conclusions on absolute observed-model soil-moisture differences for the satellite comparison.

ROM_PURPOSE: Continue representation/state-support research if scientifically useful.
Do not attach application sufficiency verdicts to current synthetic panels.
Do not import LHM groundwater criteria into synthetic GW-LB metrics.
Do not choose a threshold from S4/G4/U4/L4/L6/R8 response.
ROM_ROOT: May inherit transaction and accepted-state semantics where coupling relevant.
Must keep quantitative reduced-model application tolerance unresolved unless an independently matching authority is bound.
Root-feedback candidate response must not be used to create the acceptance envelope.

reopen_conditions: New formal project/product requirement with matching purpose, quantity, spatial and temporal support.
Complete authoritative LHM 4.1 groundwater population/manifest or an explicit public-subset purpose-owner contract.
Independent GW-R recharge error budget with aggregation and bias/drift semantics.
Independent SCI-P depth-resolved/profile timing fidelity contract.
Prospectively governed GW-D component structural-error allocation.
non_reopen_triggers: A candidate happens to achieve a convenient error level.
A generic goodness-of-fit classification is found.
A solver or mass-balance tolerance is available.
A study reports a typical RMSE without an application acceptance contract.
